notes: New: Set B papers keep a fixed order and the MCQ Auto Checker can show Set A or Set B. Papers with Attempt any X of Y now give marks that match the printed paper. The Dashboard pending count includes uncollected admission fees. User Guide has a Quick Start and 79 questions and answers with working search. Bulk actions for students and staff, print/PDF/CSV on many screens, admission date filter, and the network sync no longer broadcasts its access token.
